app.name: Sovkora
app.development: In development: still being tested, not ready for the public.

stack.title: Local stack
stack.lead: Start Sovkora on this Mac with the orazaka CLI, then open the workspace.
stack.noServices: Status not read yet — press Refresh.
stack.logsEmpty: Nothing yet. Start the stack, run doctor or fetch the service logs.
stack.sidecarMissing: The orazaka CLI is missing from this build.
stack.needsNode: The CLI needs Node.js 22 or later on this Mac (brew install node).
stack.workspaceNeeded: Choose the Sovkora workspace folder in Settings so the CLI knows where the stack lives.
stack.remoteNote: You are connected to {host}. The local stack is optional here — start it only to run Sovkora on this Mac.

files.title: Files Sovkora can read
files.lead: Sovkora can read only the folders listed here — nothing else on this Mac. You choose them, and you can take them back at any time.
files.none: No folder yet. Sovkora cannot read any file on this Mac.
files.truncated: Only the first entries are shown.
files.select: Select a file to preview it.
files.send: Send to the open workspace page
files.sendHint: Puts the file in the first file field of the workspace page (a Studio input, the knowledge base). Open the workspace and the right Studio first.
files.binary: No preview for this kind of file.
files.dropLead: A dropped file can be previewed and sent for this session only. A dropped folder is shared only if you confirm.
files.newFilesNone: Nothing new yet. Turn on “Watch for new files” on a folder.
files.forbidden: This folder cannot be shared (too broad or sensitive).

settings.title: Settings
settings.remoteHelp: https only. You sign in on the Sovkora page itself — this app never stores a password.
settings.workspaceHelp: Where orazaka.workspace.json lives. The CLI runs there; the app does not read it.
settings.startup: Start Sovkora when I log in
settings.startupHelp: Off by default. Runs in the menu bar; nothing is started unless you ask.
settings.about: Sovkora Desktop is unsigned for now: if macOS refuses to open it, right-click the app and choose Open.

automations.title: Automations
automations.lead: Work Sovkora does on its own, on this Mac, with your local model. It reads only the folder you choose and asks you before it writes anything.
automations.killSwitchOn: All agents are stopped on this Mac
automations.killSwitchOnLead: No automation runs and every schedule is paused until you resume.
automations.templateSummariseLead: Every morning, reads the PDFs that arrived in a folder and saves a short summary note next to each one.
automations.noneLead: Start from a template: Sovkora will ask you before it writes the first file.

form.name: Name
form.folderHint: Only a folder you shared in Files. Sovkora reads it and writes the notes next to the PDFs — nowhere else.
form.noFolder: Share a folder in Files first.
form.modelHint: A model served on this Mac (Ollama, LocalAI, mlx_lm.server) — nothing leaves the Mac.
form.dryRunHint: Shows what it would write, writes nothing.

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.lead: Sovkora wants to write these files. Nothing is written until you decide.
approvals.alwaysHint: Creates a permission for this automation, this tool and this folder only. You can take it back below.

grants.title: Permissions you gave
grants.none: No permanent permission. Every write asks first.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.lead: Everything automations did on this Mac, in order. Each entry is chained to the previous one: an edited or deleted line is detected.

code.title: Code
code.lead: Sovkora reads the repository you choose and proposes changes. Nothing is written until you approve each change, and one click undoes a run.
code.noneLead: Pick a folder that holds a git repository. Ignored files and secrets stay invisible to Sovkora.

checks.title: Checks
checks.lead: Commands Sovkora may run to test a change. Each one is yours to confirm, and runs without a shell, in a sandbox that can write only to the repository.
checks.none: No command is confirmed yet. A suggestion is only a proposal.
checks.needsApproval: A change since the last check altered what runs

github.title: GitHub
github.lead: Connect GitHub to carry an issue to a pull request. The token stays in the macOS Keychain; this page never sees it.
github.revokeHint: To revoke the app entirely, use your GitHub settings (Applications).
github.waiting: Waiting for you to approve in the browser…
